jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
